title: Taxat Northbound Boundary Atlas
subtitle: One shared admission scaffold turns command envelopes into typed problems or durable receipts without per-endpoint guesswork.
basisStatement: Northbound write admission is driven by explicit command family policy so every endpoint reuses the same scope, stale-guard, truth-boundary, and duplicate-handling posture instead of hand-rolling parse logic.

stages.label: PARSE
stages.summary: Read the exact northbound envelope and actor/session binding.

stages.label: VALIDATE
stages.summary: Enforce command family, mutation profile, and truth-boundary shape.

stages.label: STALE
stages.summary: Compare command-side stale guards against the current route-stability contract.

stages.label: DUPLICATE
stages.summary: Detect safe replay versus idempotency collision.

stages.label: RECEIPT
stages.summary: Emit durable ApiCommandReceipt before downstream side effects fan out.

stages.label: PROBLEM
stages.summary: Emit typed ProblemEnvelope when the command cannot be accepted safely.

stageNarrative.PARSE: Parse SUBMIT_RETURN against the imported CommandEnvelope contract and bind it to MANIFEST scope.
stageNarrative.VALIDATE: Validate MANIFEST_RENDER_FRAME exactly, reject extra stale guards, and preserve the command-request truth-boundary contract.
stageNarrative.STALE: Compare DECISION_BUNDLE_HASH, SHELL_STABILITY_TOKEN, FRAME_EPOCH against the current MANIFEST_EXPERIENCE route-stability contract.
stageNarrative.DUPLICATE: Reuse the same durable receipt for exact request replays; reject idempotency collisions instead of guessing user intent.
stageNarrative.RECEIPT: Emit ApiCommandReceipt with MANIFEST_EXPERIENCE projection posture and append-only boundary evidence.
stageNarrative.PROBLEM: Emit typed ProblemEnvelope recovery for decision_bundle-anchored rebase or hard-stop paths.

notes: Filing-capable manifest commands stay bound to the current decision bundle, shell token, and live frame epoch.
